column1: C.  Entitlement rules (apply after gates RF/MD, before the card is built)

column2: Rule in plain words
Free floor: every pathway has free tools that work in every light and setting. The engine's primary action is always something the user can open with their current plan.
Safety and access are never paid: check-in, the engine, the card, Help/SOS, the safety override, the Support Plan, communication cards, accessibility settings, export and delete.

No upselling under strain: no Advanced tiles, upgrade prompts or paywalls in Amber or Red, when any negative intensity is High or Very High, after a safety event, or during a session. In Green, Yellow or Blue at most ONE Advanced alternative is shown, labelled 'Advanced', never as the primary, and dismissing it is remembered.
Faith practice is never paid: the user's own prayers, rituals, schedules and reminders are free. Only Nuccess-produced guided content is Advanced. Belief data is never used to sell anything (MD-3).
Same safety rules in every plan: RF and MD gates, bands and guards apply equally; paying never unlocks a blocked pathway.
Lapse keeps data: if a subscription ends, the user's content stays readable and exportable; Advanced tools become locked, nothing is deleted.
Institution licences unlock Advanced for covered users; paying institutions get no extra access to individual data.
Honest pricing: clear price before purchase, cancel in two taps, no countdown pressure or guilt copy; purchases only by adults; under-18s only through an approved institution licence.
Tier changes are configuration: moving a tool between Free and Advanced needs PO approval, plus Safety Reviewer approval for anything in Regulate, Connect, communication cards or the safety floor.
